notes: Expected by the owner: INSO 23684 (1403) = ISO/IEC 25059:2023 — CONFIRMED on the pages; no difference found. Cover and preface both say identical (cover: 'Identical with ISO/IEC 25059: 2023'; preface: «معادل یکسان»).
The document contains NO numbered tables; only Figure 1 (شکل ۱), Figure 2 (شکل ۲) and Figure A.1 (شکل الف-۱).

Clause numbers are printed right-to-left with the hyphen as a neutral character, so the rendered number looks mirrored (heading of clause 5.1 reads visually «۱-۵»; 3.2.1 reads «۱-۲-۳»). All clause numbers in these JSON files are given in logical order (parent first: 3.2.1) — this is verified against the TOC hierarchy.

Preface says the draft was prepared by the relevant commissions under item (الف), clause 7 of INSO standard no. 5 and approved 1403/06/07; only a session ordinal and a date are printed — no approval number.
No URL, certification claim or ISBN-like number is printed other than the INSO contact details on page ب (standard@inso.gov.ir, http://www.inso.gov.ir) — not needed by the book.
uncertainties: No numeric INSO number is printed for the national version of ISO/IEC 25010 (clause 2.1 note); do not invent one.
International equivalents of INSO 23679 and INSO 23681 are not printed in this document.
